title: Heated spherical inclusion in a block: Eshelby thermal stress (3D, analytic)
description:
3D static elasticity (solid_mechanics_3d): a sphere of radius a inside a uniform elastic block is heated by dT (temperature_change feature on the sphere, no heat physics), so it tries to expand by alpha dT and the block holds it back. Octant model: the sphere is centred on the origin corner, rollers on x_lo, y_lo and z_lo are the three symmetry planes, the other faces are free (the full body is a free cube of side 10 a); 40^3 cubic cells, a = 8 cells.
Analytic (Eshelby, same material inside and out, infinite medium): inside a uniform hydrostatic stress sigma_in = -2 E alpha dT / (3 (1 - nu)) (-95 MPa here) and u = B r / a^3; outside u_r = B / r^2 with B = (1 + nu) / (3 (1 - nu)) alpha dT a^3, sigma_rr = -2 S a^3 / r^3, sigma_tt = S a^3 / r^3, S = E alpha dT / (3 (1 - nu)) (zero trace outside). The finite cube lowers the inside pressure by about (a / b)^3 ~ 0.4 % (b = the radius of a sphere of the cube's volume).
Derived values tab: stress_xx_inclusion and stress_zz_inclusion (means over the sphere) vs sigma_in, expect ~1-3 % (staircase sphere of voxels); stress_xx_centre (probe in the corner cell) likewise. Two exact identities (double-precision pcg solver node cg, tolerance 1e-12; expect ~1e-7): stress_xx_mean_all = mean of stress_xx over the block / |sigma_in| = 0 (a traction-free body without body force carries zero mean stress; the symmetry rollers hold only normal components, at x = 0), and strain_excess_all = mean of (strain_xx - alpha temperature_rise_ext) / (alpha dT) = 0 (so the block grows on average exactly by the inclusion's free expansion share).
Line profile tab (cut z = dx / 2, line y = dx / 2): u_x inside (linear) and outside (1 / r^2) and stress_xx outside, using the exact r of the sampled cell centres; ~2-5 % of each curve's range, largest next to the voxel surface.
Field tab: von Mises (0 inside in the analytic solution: the voxel surface shows as a thin shell of shear).

parameters.name: E_m
parameters.description: Young's modulus in Pa (inclusion and block)

parameters.name: dT_inc
parameters.description: temperature change of the inclusion in K

parameters.name: L_box
parameters.description: side of the octant model (full cube 2 L = 10 a)

parameters.name: z_cut
parameters.description: height of the line-profile cut (first cell layer, next to the z_lo symmetry plane)

parameters.name: sigma_in
parameters.description: Eshelby hydrostatic stress inside in Pa

parameters.name: S_out
parameters.description: outside stress scale in Pa (sigma_tt at r = a)

parameters.name: B_out
parameters.description: outside displacement constant, u_r = B / r^2 (m^3)
